data: What is the approximate value of the red line at 10 sort iterations?

The red line represents the effect of sorting iterations on perplexity scores for LM1B. The x-axis shows the number of sort iterations, ranging from 0 to 30. The y-axis shows the perplexity scores, ranging from approximately 42 to 52. At 10 sort iterations, the red line appears to be around 45. Therefore, the approximate value of the red line at 10 sort iterations is 45.
